documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals reported a strong financial performance for Q2 FY27, driven by double-digit volume growth in its CDMO segment with revenue increasing over 30% year-on-year and EBITDA more than doubling. Management highlighted progress on key strategic initiatives including the Oriflame plant acquisition, the upcoming Baddi manufacturing facility, and expanding global footprints in Europe and Zambia. The domestic branded and international branded segments also showed positive momentum, while the API segment continued its journey toward EBITDA breakeven. Akums Drugs reported a strong Q2 and H1 FY27 performance with revenue growing by more than 30% and EBITDA more than doubling year-on-year in Q2. The growth was primarily driven by the CDMO segment, which witnessed double-digit volume growth alongside improvements in API prices.

guidance.claim: Commercial supplies for the Zambia initiative from the Indian plant are scheduled during Q4 FY27 with revenue booking expected in Q1 FY 28.
guidance.quote: Our European CDMO project is progressing as per plan and we continue to make steady progress vis-à-vis our Zambia initiative with commercial supplies from the Indian plant scheduled during Q4 FY27 with revenue booking expected in Q1 FY 28.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates volume growth to be at least in double digits for the coming quarters.
guidance.quote: While this could be a period where we have sizable volume growth, but we remain confident that our volume growth will at least be double digits in the coming quarters.

guidance.claim: Zambia order is expected to contribute around $25 million translating to roughly INR240 crores in revenue for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: Zambia is something we expect in the H2 that we deliver for this fiscal, the $25 million, which will roughly translate to almost INR240-odd crores in our revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand outlook for CDMO remains strong.
demand_outlook.quote: While the availability and the prices of input materials remain volatile, the demand outlook for CDMO remains strong.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment for CDMO remains robust and Akums continues to deepen its presence within the IPM.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment for CDMO remains robust and Akums continues to deepen its presence within the IPM.

demand_outlook.claim: The growth was spearheaded by the CDMO segment with double digit volume growth and improvement in API prices.
demand_outlook.quote: The growth was spearheaded by the CDMO segment with double digit volume growth and improvement in API prices.

demand_outlook.claim: Our domestic branded formulations segment had a steady quarter with 8% YoY growth in revenue and marked improvement in profitability on a sequential basis.
demand_outlook.quote: Our domestic branded formulations segment had a steady quarter with 8% YoY growth in revenue and marked improvement in profitability on a sequential basis.

demand_outlook.claim: Our international branded formulations business saw growth accelerating, both on YoY and QoQ basis.
demand_outlook.quote: Our international branded formulations business saw growth accelerating, both on YoY and QoQ basis.

demand_outlook.claim: The consistent performance of the CDMO segment showcases a healthy demand environment.
demand_outlook.quote: The consistent performance of CDMO showcases healthy demand environment as well as our clients' trust in Akums as the preferred manufacturing partners.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully integrated 2 manufacturing plants acquired from Oriflame.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we successfully integrated the 2 manufacturing plants acquired from Oriflame.

capex_expansion.claim: Our European CDMO project is progressing as per plan and we continue to make steady progress vis-à-vis our Zambia initiative.
capex_expansion.quote: Our European CDMO project is progressing as per plan and we continue to make steady progress vis-à-vis our Zambia initiative with commercial supplies from the Indian plant scheduled during Q4 FY27 with revenue booking expected in Q1 FY 28.

capex_expansion.claim: The company announced the acquisition of Oriflame India's manufacturing business covering facilities in Roorkee and Noida along with a leased warehouse.
capex_expansion.quote: On 23rd of July, we announced the acquisition of Oriflame India's manufacturing business. The transaction covers two manufacturing facilities, one at Roorkee, Uttarakhand and other one at Noida, Uttar Pradesh, along with a leased warehouse situated at Noida, Uttar Pradesh.

capex_expansion.claim: Akums is in the process of setting up a new facility in Baddi that will go live near the end of the financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: So we are in the process of setting up one more facility in Baddi, which will go live in the -- almost at the end of this financial year itself, which will significantly boost our oral manufacturing capabilities, right?

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margins for the quarter stood at 14.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Margins were healthy at 14.5% as against 9.3% in Q2 FY26 and 15% in Q1 FY27.

margins_costs.claim: API segment EBITDA loss was INR5.7 crores for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA loss was slightly higher on this quarter, which is INR 5.7 crores while significantly lower than Q2 FY26 INR14 crores, however, higher than Q1 FY27 at INR3.9 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Trade generics segment remained EBITDA positive for the third straight quarter, standing at INR1.2 crores.
margins_costs.quote: The trade generics segment remained EBITDA positive during the quarter with the third straight quarter of achieving profitability.

margins_costs.claim: API segment continued on its journey towards achieving EBITDA break even as our endeavours continued.
margins_costs.quote: API segment continued on its journey towards achieving EBITDA break even as our endeavours continued.

margins_costs.claim: The trade generic segment cemented EBITDA positivity during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: The trade generic segment cemented EBITDA positivity during the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Other exp and employee exp benefitted from operating leverage.
margins_costs.quote: • Other exp and employee exp benefitted from operating leverage

margins_costs.claim: GM improvement led by CDMO and API segments.
margins_costs.quote: • GM improvement led by CDMO and API segments

margins_costs.claim: Margins in the domestic branded formulation segment were impacted due to increased employee strength.
margins_costs.quote: Margins were impacted due to an increase in employee strength.

margins_costs.claim: API gross margins improved as the segment reduced COGS from over 90% last year to almost 75% this quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So API, we used to operate last year at almost 90% plus cogs. But in this quarter, we are almost at 75% cogs, right? So this has also been a positive.

orders_capacity.claim: The company currently operates at healthy utilization levels of above 50%.
orders_capacity.quote: We today operate at healthy utilization levels of above 50%.

orders_capacity.claim: Total peak utilization can move up to 55%, 58%, or 60-odd percent.
orders_capacity.quote: We have already -- we are already at 50-odd percent, right? So the strategy remains given there's a continued focus on better quality drugs in the market. There are increasing opportunities of volume growth. We are in process of further expanding our capacities.

capital_allocation.claim: Consolidated cash and cash equivalents stand at INR1,680 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet continues to remain healthy and cash and cash equivalent as has been constantly increasing stands at INR1,680 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The balance sheet remains healthy with a cash surplus of INR1,616 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet continues to remain very healthy with a cash surplus of INR1,616 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Approximately 98% of the cash is parked safely in fixed deposits with nationalized banks.
capital_allocation.quote: Most of the money, in fact, 98% of the money is parked in fixed deposits with nationalized banks, right? And the money is safely with these banks.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that availability and prices of input materials remain volatile.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the availability and the prices of input materials remain volatile, the demand outlook for CDMO remains strong.

risks_headwinds.claim: API prices remain volatile, though moving upwards at present.
risks_headwinds.quote: API prices, they are volatile, right? But at this point in time, they are volatile, moving upwards.

management_commitments.claim: The new Baddi facility Phase 1 will fully operationalize by Q1 FY28.
management_commitments.quote: The plant will have oral solids in Phase 1 with an annual capacity of over 6 billion units, which will fully operationalize by Q1 FY28.

management_commitments.claim: European CDMO supplies are expected to commence in FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Our European CDMO project is progressing as per our stated plans with supplies commencing in FY28.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial supplies from the Indian plant for the Zambia JV are scheduled during Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our JV with the Zambia government is also progressing smoothly with commercial supplies from the Indian plant scheduled during Q4 FY27 and considering the prolonged shipping time to Zambia, we expect to book revenues during Q1 FY28.

management_commitments.claim: The plant in Zambia is expected to become operational in 2029.
management_commitments.quote: The plant is expected to become operational in 2029, expanding our manufacturing presence outside India.

management_commitments.claim: Domestic branded formulations segment is expected to deliver growth on par with IPM by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: We expect the segment to deliver growth on par with IPM by FY28 as the current initiatives start bearing fruits.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial supplies for the Zambia initiative from the Indian plant are scheduled during Q4 FY27 with revenue booking expected in Q1 FY 28.
management_commitments.quote: Our European CDMO project is progressing as per plan and we continue to make steady progress vis-à-vis our Zambia initiative with commercial supplies from the Indian plant scheduled during Q4 FY27 with revenue booking expected in Q1 FY 28.

management_commitments.claim: Domestic branded formulation segment performance is expected to improve from quarter 3 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: We expected improved performance from the segment from quarter 3 onwards.

management_commitments.claim: Zambia order delivery is expected to happen in H2 of the current fiscal year.
management_commitments.quote: Zambia is something we expect in the H2 that we deliver for this fiscal, the $25 million, which will roughly translate to almost INR240-odd crores in our revenue.

management_commitments.claim: The European business will be kickstarted within the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: And within the next financial year, we will kickstart our European business as well, which will -- so both of these businesses will uplift the corporate margins.

management_commitments.claim: The API business is expected to achieve monthly EBITDA positive status by February or March.
management_commitments.quote: So the whole target is on a monthly level, at least by the end of February, March, we should be monthly EBITDA positive in this business.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
